flows.title: Live journey (L016) — enter live → inspect → interruption → replay

assertions.name: the journey starts from a fresh (anonymous) browser on the home page
the Live entry is reachable through the product's own primary navigation
the live page lists the real sources (the transport's own listing)
an anonymous browser is honestly REFUSED the live stream (fail-closed, never a silent anonymous live picture)
assertions.evidence: data-live-phase=failed; the real 401 path (auth-required) surfaced as the view's own failure state

assertions.name: entering the live match shows LIVE tactical state (frames really arriving)
assertions.evidence: data-live-phase=live; captured frames=8; canvas label="Live tactical pitch: world version 9, 24 entities at event time 1s"

assertions.name: the entity inspector offers the live entities (players and the ball)
inspecting a PLAYER shows its identity + live state, updating while pinned
assertions.evidence: pinned="p-home-01 · PLAYER · team-home"; position x 2.70 · y 24.56 → x 2.55 · y 24.16; confidence=0.94

assertions.name: inspecting the BALL shows its identity + live state, updating while pinned
assertions.evidence: pinned="ball-1 · BALL"; position x 91.76 · y 9.25 → x 84.12 · y 8.89; detection=detected

assertions.name: the interruption source (the L002 reconnect scenario) is selected through the product's picker
the interruption is EXPLICIT (the stream's own gap accounting, counted — never silent)
assertions.evidence: recovery event: missedUpdates=8, gapDurationMs=800; captured frames=41

assertions.name: the interrupted state is VISIBLE to the user (the honest event ticker carries the accounted gap)
assertions.evidence: ticker row="source reconnect — 8 updates missed (0.8s gap, accounted)"

assertions.name: the journey CONTINUES after the recovery (updates keep arriving past the interruption)
assertions.evidence: world version at recovery=v41; latest=v45 (45 frames captured)

assertions.name: the finite live-window session is selected through the product's picker
assertions.evidence: picker answer="selected"; label="Synthetic live tracking — finite window + replay"

assertions.name: the finite live window streams live state first (the window is live before it ends)
the live window ENDS honestly and the SAME surface opens the replay of the recorded session
assertions.evidence: data-live-phase=replay; replay controls present; legend="Replay the recorded live window — 24 world frames (world v1 → v24)"

assertions.name: the replay carries the recorded session state through the SAME views (world versions + frame accounting visible)
assertions.evidence: world version fact="1 (recorded — of 24)"; frames fact="24 recorded"

assertions.name: the opened replay is user-drivable (a step advances the recorded frame)

notes: signed in a fresh viewer account through the real register form (e2e-live-l016-musvrvb8)
determinism fingerprint (the journey's normal-session window, first 8 captured frames): v1@0#seq1 v2@100#seq2 v3@200#seq3 v4@300#seq4 v5@400#seq5 v6@500#seq6 v7@600#seq7 v8@700#seq8
